about: Features that are switched on and off by a setting in a file, or by renaming a file. The site doctor and the admin panel's Site status section read these read-only and report each one's state; `type` selects the reader in lib/site-features.php, `needs` are files that must exist for the feature to be installed at all. `pause: true` marks the few features the admin panel may switch OFF (never on): only for the types studio-config, json-enabled and private-config-php. Only the fields a reader lists are ever reported; every other value in a config file (passwords, tokens, keys) is never output.

features.label: Asset Studio minting
features.about: The Studio page and its validator work without this; minting needs it.
features.enable: In the Studio private folder, set "mintEnabled": true in studio-config.json. "domain" must be exactly this host and "origins" must include https://<this host>.
features.disable: Set "mintEnabled": false in studio-config.json. It applies to the next request.

features.label: Ledger account credentials (experimental)
features.about: Off unless the file exists and says enabled.
features.disable: Set "enabled": false in that file, or delete it.

features.label: Signed ledger balance receipts (experimental)
features.about: Off unless the file exists and says enabled. Independent of ledger account credentials.
features.disable: Set "enabled": false in that file, or delete it.

features.label: Email-delivered tickets
features.about: Outbound mail needs smtpHost and fromAddress. A missing imapHost turns inbound transfers off. The file holds mail passwords; the doctor only says whether a login is set.
features.enable: Create lib/atlas-email-tickets-config.json with smtpHost, smtpPort, smtpSecure, smtpUser, smtpPass and fromAddress (and imapHost, imapUser, imapPass for inbound).
features.disable: Remove smtpHost from that file, or delete it.

features.label: Transfer to file (export a credential to a file)
features.about: Opt-in in the domain manifest. An empty object allows every eligible class.
features.enable: Add "fileTransfer": {} (every eligible class) or {"classes": ["class.id"]} at the top level of .well-known/spatial.json.

features.label: Moderation grants (issuer side)
features.about: Needs a domain and at least one presence endpoint it may address grants to.
features.disable: Empty the "audiences" list, or delete the file.

features.label: Moderation (presence service side)
features.about: Read on every request. A file that cannot be parsed disables moderation.
features.enable: Create presence/lib/atlas-presence-moderation-config.json with "audience" and a "domains" object (see docs/moderation-setup.md).
features.disable: Set "enabled": false in that file, or delete it.

features.label: Transaction Lab
features.about: Off unless a private folder outside the web root has a valid config.php with enabled true and no DISABLED file. The public demo is a separate switch inside the same file.
features.enable: Copy inc/private-dir.php.example to inc/private-dir.php, then run atlas/demo/txlab/tools/txlab-admin.php config ... --enable (see docs/txlab-deployment.md).
features.disable: Create a file named DISABLED in the private folder (it applies at once), or set 'enabled' => false in config.php.

features.label: Multi-issuer lab
features.about: Same pattern as the Transaction Lab: private folder, config.php with enabled true, a DISABLED file turns it off.
features.enable: Copy inc/private-dir.php.example to inc/private-dir.php, then run atlas/demo/multi-issuer/tools/mi-admin.php config ... --enable (see docs/multi-issuer-deployment.md).
features.disable: Create a file named DISABLED in the private folder, or set 'enabled' => false in config.php.

features.label: Call service (voice calls)
features.about: Until config.php exists the service answers "calls-not-configured". Renaming config.php to config.php.off switches it off and keeps the settings.
features.enable: Rename atlas/call/lib/config.php.off to config.php (or copy config.example.php to config.php and fill it in).

features.label: Issuer private state folder (outside the web root)
features.about: Where replay records, holdings and transaction journals live. Without it they are in lib/ (protected by lib/.htaccess). Choose it before first use and do not change it afterwards.
features.enable: Put the absolute path of an existing, writable folder outside the web root in lib/atlas-private-dir.txt, before the issuer is first used.
features.disable: Do not remove it once the issuer has state: the code never falls back to lib/.
